name: Doppelganger
summary: A shape-shifting monstrosity that reads thoughts, imitates humanoids, and unsettles foes with its true face.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The doppelganger makes two Slam attacks and uses Unsettling Visage if available.

actions.name: Slam
actions.attackNote: with Advantage during the first round of each combat

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.text: The doppelganger casts *{ref:spell/detect-thoughts}*, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {dc:con}).

actions.name: Unsettling Visage

save.targets: each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the doppelganger that can see the doppelganger

actions.onFailure: The target has the Frightened condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.text: The doppelganger shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.
